title: Hom-complex quasi-isomorphism invariance with an independent smaller ring universe
statement: Let C : Type u be a category with morphisms in Type v, J a Grothendieck topology on C, and R a sheaf of commutative rings in Type r. Set m=max(u,v,r). Assume abelian sheafification and its locally bijective characterization on J in universe m, and assume forgetting commutativity sends R to a ring sheaf. Let I',I,L',L be integer-indexed cochain complexes of R-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] whose sections lie in Type m. Suppose I' and I are K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex], and s:I'→I and t:L'→L are quasi-isomorphisms [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Then the Hom-complex map [def-pur-hom-complex] from Hom(L,I') to Hom(L',I) given by f↦s f t is a quasi-isomorphism. The coefficient ring itself stays in universe r; no enlargement of its sections is made.

source.place: Lemma 0A95 (lemma-RHom-well-defined), Lemma 0A94 (lemma-RHom-into-K-injective), and Equation 0A8Y; exact localized extension from sites-modules.tex, Tags 03DI and 03DJ.

proof.text: Restriction to C/U is exact: its composite with the exact conservative underlying-abelian-sheaf functor is the underlying sheaf restriction, which preserves finite limits and finite colimits. It preserves K-injectives because the explicit sheafified direct-sum extension is an exact additive left adjoint (siteModuleExtensionByZero_exact); apply Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes.

The product projections of homComplex identify sections in degree n over U with all degree-n cochains between the restricted complexes. Evaluation preserves the product cone. The differential projection formula gives d_I f - (-1)^n f d_L, which equals the external Hom-complex differential. Consequently these additive degreewise equivalences form an isomorphism of complexes. The resulting equivalences on cycles and homology send a cocycle to its shifted chain map and its homotopy class. The projection formula for homComplexFunctor maps sends the family f to s f t, so the comparison is natural in arbitrary s and t.

The restricted K-injective targets remain K-injective after integer shift. CochainComplex.IsKInjective.Qh_map_bijective identifies both homotopy-category Hom sets with derived-category Hom sets. Exact restriction preserves s and t; their shifted and unshifted quotient images are inverted by Qh. For an arbitrary functor with bijective maps on the two Hom sets, invertibility of the images of t and s implies that composition k↦tks is bijective: compose with the functor, use composition with inverse images in the codomain, then reflect bijectivity. Apply this generic fact to Qh and the natural sectionwise homology comparison.

The underlying abelian presheaf map is a quasi-isomorphism because evaluation is exact and detects homology isomorphisms. Exact abelian sheafification preserves this quasi-isomorphism; its counit identifies the sheafified presheaf complexes with the original underlying abelian sheaf complexes. The exact conservative functor from module sheaves to abelian sheaves reflects quasi-isomorphisms. This gives the asserted module-sheaf quasi-isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: 0A95 and 0A94; adapts the sectionwise proof with independent ring and module-section sizes. Uses Qh directly on homotopy-category morphisms.
